name: Seville
summary: Seville is the capital of Andalusia and one of the cities with the most historical heritage in Spain, with the Giralda, the Cathedral and the Real Alcázar declared World Heritage Sites. The cost of living is notably lower than in Madrid or Barcelona, ​​while the quality of life and safety remain high. The city has an expanding tech and coworking community, driven in part by tourism and remote professionals attracted by its climate and affordable cost. Of course, its summers are extremely hot - with maximum temperatures frequently exceeding 40°C between June and August - so spring and autumn are the most recommended seasons to settle.
